description: Fork of exp642 (tiny SOTA = 1.5153 @ 38.34M, bs=16). Two changes: (1) qkv_lut -> qk_lut (n_out 2*d_qk+d_v=144 -> 2*d_qk=128); v_branch from joint LUT removed; v_lut alone provides v. (2) v_lut shape (NAP=8, tph=32) -> (NAP=6, tph=128). v_lut weights per layer unchanged (6*32*256*16 = 6*128*64*16 = 786,432), but K=256->64 for better bs=16 gradient coverage (same hypothesis as exp642 on out_proj). qk_lut weights per layer drop from 884,736 to 786,432 (-98,304/layer * 6 = -590k). Expected total params ~37.75M. Reference: exp642 = 1.5153, exp639 = 1.5182, exp641 = 1.5101 (58.98M), vanilla SOTA exp328 = 1.3882.
